title: Differential compatibility of currying
statement: For every cochain complexes K,L,M of sheaf modules over R and integers n,m, the chosen degreewise currying morphisms satisfy homTensorDegreewiseMap K L M n followed by the differential from n to m on the total-tensor Hom complex equals the differential from n to m on the iterated Hom complex followed by homTensorDegreewiseMap K L M m.

mathlib_searches.results: No exact theorem; only generic homological complex maps.

mathlib_searches.query: Hom complex tensor total in Mathlib/Algebra/Homology

lean.statement: theorem homTensorDegreewiseMap_comm (K L M : CochainComplex Mod ℤ) (n m : ℤ) : letI := SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory R homTensorDegreewiseMap R K L M n ≫ (homComplex (R := R) (CochainComplex.mapBifunctor K L (curriedTensor Mod)) M).d n m = (homComplex (R := R) K (homComplex (R := R) L M)).d n m ≫ homTensorDegreewiseMap R K L M m
